meta.note: Every review is a verbatim English quote from a public student post, linked to its source page. quote_zh is the collector's own Chinese translation of the quote, for reference only — the English quote is the verbatim original. No star rating is recorded (PathPilot does not collect ratings). Missing fields are null — never invented. See docs/SCHOOL_REVIEWS.md for method, exclusions and gaps.
meta.quote_zh_note: 中文翻译由收集者翻译，仅供参考；英文 quote 为来源页原文，一字未改。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I am very satisfied with what I learnt. I spent a lot of time on projects and hands-on tasks. It was rigorous but all worth it in the end, as it was a mentally stimulating course
reviews.quote_zh: 我对所学非常满意。我花了大量时间做项目和动手任务。课程很严谨，但最终一切都值得，这是一门能激发思考的课程。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I am really satisfied with the university, the course I chose and the country.
reviews.quote_zh: 我对这所大学、所选的课程和这个国家都非常满意。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: My university and course were good, but I would've preferred having more contact classes.
reviews.quote_zh: 我的大学和课程都很好，但我更希望有更多的面授课时。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I love my major although it’s tough
reviews.quote_zh: 我喜欢我的专业，尽管它很难。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I’ve really enjoyed my experience at this university. The teaching staff are supportive and knowledgeable, and they are always willing to help students develop their ideas and improve their work.
reviews.quote_zh: 我在大学的体验真的很愉快。教学人员平易近人、学识渊博，总是乐于帮助学生发展想法、改进作品。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: My experience on the graphic design course has been largely disappointing. Communication from the course tutors has been poor, with seminars and tutorials frequently cancelled or students turning up on the wrong days due to unclear information.
reviews.quote_zh: 我在平面设计课程上的体验总体上令人失望。课程导师的沟通很差，研讨课和辅导课经常被取消，或者学生因信息不明确而在错误的时间到场。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: Before coming here, I was very study-oriented. Now I know everything is important in life. Studying and enjoying should go hand in hand for best productivity.
reviews.quote_zh: 来这里之前，我一心只想学习。现在我明白，生活中的每件事都很重要。学习与享受并行，才能达到最佳状态。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.programme: MSc in Mathematical and Theoretical Physics
reviews.quote: As for the uni itself, the place is an academic pressure cooker. The pace of the course is relentless, but they don't just leave you out to dry
reviews.quote_zh: 至于大学本身，这里就像一座学术高压锅。课程节奏毫不留情，但他们不会对你置之不理。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: The professors and peers are generally quite open and helpful.
reviews.quote_zh: 教授和同学们总体上都非常开放、乐于助人。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: NUS is a university which rewards you for what you put into it.
reviews.quote_zh: 新国立是一所你付出多少就回报多少的大学。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: People who are planning to join the university, especially for the Data Science course should make sure their math and statistics foundation is pretty good because students have to take at least 2 statistics subjects each semester.
reviews.quote_zh: 打算来这所大学、尤其是数据科学课程的同学，一定要确保数学和统计基础扎实，因为每个学期至少要修两门统计课。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I am very satisfied with my experience at university.
reviews.quote_zh: 我对在大学的体验非常满意。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I am very satisfied with my education. I feel very confident about my future career options because of the skills and the opportunities I have gained over the last 4 years at the university.
reviews.quote_zh: 我对所受的教育非常满意。我对未来的职业选择很有信心，因为过去四年在大学里获得的技能和机会让我受益匪浅。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: I have had a mostly positive experience at university and it has taught me to become more self reliant and capable than before.
reviews.quote_zh: 我在大学的经历总体上是积极的，它让我比以前更加自立、更有能力。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: Culture has a lot to offer, there are formal halls, BOPs, exchange with Oxford, you meet very interesting people, the social culture is great, the sports are great, and there are many activities on offer which you can partake in either as part of the whole university or as a college.
reviews.quote_zh: 这里的文化丰富多彩，有正式晚宴、舞会、与牛津的交流活动，你会遇到非常有趣的人，社交文化很棒，体育活动也很棒，还有很多活动可以参加，无论是以整个大学还是学院的名义。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: Cambridge is a world-class university that is very rigorous academically. If you think getting in is tough, wait until you start studying your course.
reviews.quote_zh: 剑桥是一所世界一流的大学，学术上非常严谨。如果你觉得考进来很难，那就等开始上课再说吧。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: It's great value for money, as I got more in return than what I paid for in my course.
reviews.quote_zh: 性价比很高，我从课程中得到的回报超过了所付出的学费。

reviews.label: 网友分享，未经官方核实
reviews.quote: Very happy with my experience, will recommend 10/10.
reviews.quote_zh: 我对自己的体验非常满意，推荐指数 10/10。
